header.build: python library/build_word_map.py (--check rebuilds and compares sha256)
header.category_rule: category = the chosen senses' lexname category when they agree (several -> 'other', candidates listed); else the library's by_kind/by_default_role category; both written, a difference flagged 'disagreement', never overridden
header.morphy_note: verb.exc etc. are not in the data drop; -n/-en are added verb rules so participles like 'thrown' reach 'throw'
header.readers_note: NOTHING in the agent reads this file (tests/test_word_map.py W0).
header.sense_choice_rule: Candidates: the entry name's head word (the last content word, or the last before 'of'), or the whole name as a WordNet collocation when it is one, looked up in index.* of every part of speech through morphy. Each candidate synset scores 2 per context lexname fit (the entry's DOMAIN and ATTRIBUTE_INDEX clusters against CLUSTER_LEXNAMES) plus 1 per context word (domain, clusters, tag names, definition and grid meaning; never the name's own words) found among the synset's gloss words, lemmas and hypernym lemmas. Chosen: the top-scoring synset(s) when the top score is > 0; every synset tied at the top is recorded (status 'tie'), none dropped. A sole candidate is chosen as 'sole_sense' (no choice to make). Several candidates and no context evidence: status 'no_context', nothing chosen -- never a pick by spelling or by frequency rank.
header.shape_bridge_note: shape_bridge is a DECLARED CONVENTION (authored in build_word_map.SHAPE_BRIDGE, visible and movable), not derived; each name resolves to the first index-order sense with the named lexname (and gloss cue); unresolved names are listed in shape_bridge_dropped
header.standing_note: every row is a preloaded prediction with NO standing (C3); stamps (C6) name the stage and corpus; the board tests them
header.what: library entry -> WordNet 3.0 senses -> category; word -> entry by shared synset; object concept -> action verbs (gloss and '+' derivation); a declared 2D -> 3D -> object shape bridge. Groundwork for word/concept -> action.
